title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta22

## Field fixes after beta21 diagnostics

This beta keeps the existing ZoneLedger, progress and current-cycle trail ownership
semantics unchanged. It focuses on three issues visible after beta21 field testing:
a stale weather-delay flag across managed Schedule windows, live-tail cutting
classification, and unnecessary prepared static-render rebuilds.

### Schedule weather-delay freshness

- Timestamp actual MQTT type-4 `taskDelay` observations instead of treating the
  retained cached value as permanently current.
- When a weather-interrupted retained task crosses into a later managed Schedule
  window, an old `taskDelay=true` no longer blocks Resume forever.
- A fresh type-4 delay inside the new window still holds the task, and same-window
  behavior remains unchanged.
- Fresh vendor weather events `150A` / `150F` remain independent supporting
  evidence.
- Retained-task continuation stays non-resetting and keeps the existing strict
  scheduler ownership checks.

### MQTT live-tail cutting truth

- Use the MQTT cutting action as the authoritative per-point test whenever the
  action is present: action 5/8 is cutting, another action splits the trail even
  if the broader activity label still says `mowing`.
- Fall back to the activity label only for older/history points that do not contain
  an action field.
- This prevents travel or transient non-cutting movement from being painted into
  the current mowing tail.

### Prepared static render stability

- Remove diagnostic-only georeference fields such as `local_frame_check` and
  `reference_candidates` from the prepared static render identity.
- The prepared static resource now rebuilds only when render-relevant map or
  georeference data changes, not when polling refreshes diagnostics.
- Real georeference changes still invalidate and rebuild the prepared static
  resource.

### Deliberately unchanged

- Per-zone percentages and reset detection.
- ZoneLedger cycle identity.
- VendorTrailStore ownership and confirmed-cycle replacement rules.
- The rule that a scheduled-but-not-yet-entered zone retains its previous
  percentage and trail until actual vendor evidence starts a new cycle.
- Map Card behavior and protocol; no Map Card release is required for beta22.

The more aggressive frozen-base/live-tail raster optimization is not included in
this beta. The current vendor SVG remains authoritative so no gap can appear
between a frozen raster endpoint and a newer vendor-confirmed prefix.
